Privacy policy

Last updated 11 June 2026

This policy explains what personal data Golfsocial collects through this website, why, and the rights you have. We keep it short, and we only collect what we actually need.

Who we are

Golfsocial is the data controller for the personal data covered by this policy. You can reach us any time at hello@golfsocial.club.

What we collect

If you sign up for our newsletter, we collect the email address you enter. That is the only personal data we ask you for. We do not ask for your name, and we do not track you across the web.

When you visit, our hosting provider automatically processes standard technical information, such as your IP address and browser type, in order to deliver the website and keep it secure. We do not use this to identify or profile you.

Why, and the legal basis

We use your email only to send you the newsletter and occasional updates about Golfsocial. The legal basis is your consent under the GDPR, Article 6(1)(a), which you give when you sign up and can withdraw at any time. The legal basis for the technical data above is our legitimate interest in running a secure website, Article 6(1)(f).

Who processes your data

We use MailerLite to store our subscriber list and send the newsletter. MailerLite acts as our data processor under a data processing agreement. Our hosting provider processes the technical data above on our behalf, also under a data processing agreement. We never sell or rent your data, and we only share it where the law requires us to.

Where your data is stored

Your data is stored within the EU/EEA. If a provider ever needs to process data outside the EU/EEA, we make sure an appropriate safeguard is in place, such as the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.

How long we keep it

We keep your email until you unsubscribe or ask us to delete it. Every newsletter has a one-click unsubscribe link. Technical server data is kept only briefly, for security and troubleshooting.

Security

We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your data against loss, misuse and unauthorised access. Access to the subscriber list is limited to people who need it.

Your rights

Under the GDPR you have the right to:

  • access the data we hold about you;
  • have it corrected or deleted;
  • restrict or object to how we use it;
  • receive it in a portable format;
  • and withdraw your consent at any time.

To use any of these rights, email hello@golfsocial.club, and we will respond within one month. Withdrawing your consent does not affect anything we lawfully did before you withdrew it.

Automated decisions and profiling

We do not use your data for automated decision-making or profiling.

Children

The website is not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect data from anyone under 13 without consent from a holder of parental responsibility.

Cookies and local storage

This website does not use tracking cookies. We store your language choice locally in your browser so the site remembers it. That is functional only and never leaves your device.

Complaints

If you believe we handle your data incorrectly, you have the right to complain to the Danish Data Protection Agency, Datatilsynet, at datatilsynet.dk.

Changes to this policy

If we change this policy, we will update the date at the top, and for material changes we will let subscribers know by email.

Contact

Questions about your data? Write to hello@golfsocial.club.
